notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hi all,

The new update for Live Wallpaper Master has been released, which adds improved multi-monitor support, fixes some performance issues and updates Editor with new animation tools and improvements. 

[h1]Improved Multi-Monitor Support[/h1]
You can now set live wallpapers separately on each monitor in multi-monitor setups. Up to 3 monitors are supported.  All the issues with incorrect animations on multi-monitor setups have been fixed.


[h1]Improved Performance[/h1]
High CPU usage issues has been fixed. An automatic pause function has been added in case a game or another graphic application occupies the same monitor. 
 
[h1]Live Wallpaper Editor Update[/h1]
New animations and tools have been added to the Wallpaper Editor. Here is the full list of recent changes and bug fixes:
[list]
[*]New Tear animation has been added.
[*]New Interwoven lines animation has been added
[*]New Fire sparkles animation has been added.
[*]New Smoke 3 animation has been added.
[*]New Smoke 4 animation has been added.
[*]New Waving line animation has been added.
[*]New Shimmer animation has been added.
[*]New Psychedelic smoke animation has been added.
[*]New Multiply blending mode has been added to Line animations
[*]New position jitter controls have been added to several particle system.
[*]New particle color schemes have been added: gradient and color set.
[*]Save/Load function has been added to the particle image library.
[*]New Smoke group particle image has been added to the particle image library.
[*]Color selection preview function has been added to all color selection dialogs.
[*]Reverse animation option has been added to Path animation settings.
[*]Bugs in the particle image library have been fixed.
[*]The bug with line animation after opening an existing project has been fixed
[*]The issue with the speed has been fixed in Magic path animation.
[*]The issue with the transparency has been fixed in ‘Through the space’ animation.
[*]Glowing option in Fireflies animation has been fixed
[*]Errors in case of deletion of workshop item with Steam client have been fixed.
[*]Errors in case of importing project from DP Animation Maker have been fixed.
[/list]
[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
New tags for filtering items in workshop by size have been added. You can now limit the search results by wallpaper resolution and aspect ratio.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1]What’s New[/h1]
A new type of animation tool has been added: line based animations.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Now you can submit workshop items with non-english characters in the title.
Bug with the fire brush on dual monitor setup has been fixed.
Bug with incorrect wallpaper position on some dual monitor setup has been fixed.
Bug with editing wallpapers with sounds has been fixed.
